label: Brisnik OP-PAIN4
title: Antidepressant for non-specific low back pain
statement: Prescribed any antidepressant for non-specific low back pain - and the patient has no other indications for an antidepressant

source.document: Brisnik V, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: indicators of high-risk and overprescribing. BMC Med 2024;22:193, Tables 3-4
source.citation: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w
source.credit: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w

plain_summary: Any antidepressant used only for low back pain with no clear cause, when the person has no other reason to take an antidepressant, may not be helping.

medicine_groups.name: Antidepressants
medicine_groups.note: Every antidepressant counts, including the older tricyclic antidepressants at low doses. A bupropion supply for smoking cessation does not count as treatment for back pain. For a combination product, check the recorded ingredients and treatment indication before counting it. Enlafax-XR may appear as Enlafax XR on older records.

needs_facts.what: Non-specific low back pain treated with this antidepressant
needs_facts.meets: The record or pharmacist links this antidepressant to low back pain with no identified cause. A back pain diagnosis alone leaves the purpose open. A different sole purpose rules this out.

options.words: This antidepressant treats low back pain with no identified cause
This antidepressant is used only for another purpose

needs_facts.what: Another current antidepressant indication besides non-specific low back pain
needs_facts.meets: A review confirms there is no other current indication for an antidepressant besides non-specific low back pain. Any documented current alternative indication rules out the finding. If this has not been assessed, the answer is unknown.

options.words: No other current indication besides non-specific low back pain was found on review
Another current indication besides non-specific low back pain was confirmed

rule_for_models: Require a Group A antidepressant supply. Confirm only when an entry links that medicine to non-specific low back pain and a review confirms no other current antidepressant indication. Any documented current alternative indication or use solely for another purpose excludes a finding. With a back pain entry or pharmacist answer suggesting non-specific low back pain, report a possible finding if the medicine link or the indication review is unresolved. Name only the unresolved facts: "Non-specific low back pain treated with this antidepressant" if the medicine link is unclear, and "Another current antidepressant indication besides non-specific low back pain" if the review is missing or inconclusive. Cite the supply and supporting entries. An antidepressant supply alone gives no finding.
cannot_be_seen: Why the antidepressant was started, whether the back pain has a known cause, and any reason for an antidepressant that the record does not hold. Also medicines supplied by a hospital or another pharmacy.
ask_the_gp: What is the antidepressant being used for? If it is for non-specific low back pain, could we review its benefit, adverse effects and any other indication?
